## Findings

### Tom Hanks' Career (1999–2004)
Tom Hanks won the Best Actor award in 2000. He voiced Sheriff Woody in *Toy Story 2* (1999). He played Paul Edgecomb in *The Green Mile*, Chuck Noland in *Cast Away* (2000), Michael Sullivan, Sr. in *Road to Perdition* (2002), FBI Agent Carl Hanratty in *Catch Me If You Can*, Professor G.H. Dorr in *The Ladykillers* (2004), and Viktor Navorski in *The Terminal*.

### Angela Harmon's Modeling Career
Angela Harmon worked as a model in Italy in 1990.

### Dark Comedy Starring Debby Ryan
A dark comedy starring Debby Ryan follows a bullied teen who seeks revenge after a dramatic physical transformation. The show leaned heavily into satire, exploring themes of beauty standards, obsession, and pageant culture in exaggerated ways.

### *The Glory* (2022) – Korean Revenge Drama
*The Glory* (2022) is a dark and emotional Korean revenge drama that follows Moon Dong-eun, a woman brutally bullied during her high school years. It is a Korean revenge drama about someone seeking revenge on their bullies, and it was released in 2022. It is also described as a Korean revenge drama about school bullying and revenge, and is classified as a school bullying Korean drama.

### Rankings and Related Projects
*The Glory* is ranked first among the best school bullying K-dramas. Hwang In-yeop has a new drama with Lee Hyeri called *Dream to You*.
